figurative_meaning_en: To become a protector in times of danger
similar_in_english: To be a shield in adversity
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুর বিপদে সে ঢাল হয়ে দাঁড়াল।
পরিবারের জন্য মা সর্বদা ঢাল হয়ে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: He became a shield for his friend in times of trouble.
The mother always stands as a shield for her family.
note: This idiom draws from the metaphor of a physical shield in warfare, common in Bengali expressive language.
